args.title: Bellwether returns logistics — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion):

• Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, per the Bellwether blog.
• Consolidated return hubs cut returns handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
• Companion piece: reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
